page_note: Page contains end of Chapter 37 (Concerning the three Zones — Living Spirit's cosmic architecture, dense substrate teaching) and opening of Chapter 38 (Concerning the Mind of Light). First half is high-purity substrate cosmology mapping zones-within-zones, five powers of Darkness, five heaven-men, sons of the Living Spirit. Second half pivots to a disciple's question that RECAPS prior substrate teaching — Mind of Light entering body, binding Old Man in five counsels/five members. The recap content is substratic but wrapped in 'you have said to us' dialogue scaffolding. Editorial fatigue score (+1.81) reflects this dialogue-frame surge in segs 19-21, but the embedded teaching content is substrate. Heavy lacunae (~74% damage ratio).
